topic: Bluma Zeigarnik Berlin Cafe Waiter & Interrupted Puzzle Memory Discovery, Working-Memory Goal Tension & Concrete Shutdown Plans (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: End-of-day planning experiments proving a sixty-second concrete place-and-time plan silences intrusive unfinished-task loops without midnight labor.
